_doc: Tours, hands-on (gameplay plan: sell tickets at the pier, guide the tour, tour rating). The tours themselves (id, name, hour, price, cost, seats) stay in customization.json operations.tours; here are the guided stops and the pier places. Buyers come to the booth in the hours before a departure; the player sells (the guide sells by himself). In the departure hour the player can guide: three stops, each with a good, an acceptable and a bad choice (shown shuffled); rating = 2 + 1 per good + 0.5 per acceptable, tip = 10% of the tickets per good choice. Not guided by the end of that hour: the guide runs it (rating 3.5) or, without a guide, it is cancelled and refunded. World cm: booth = E target [x, y, z, yaw], queue = first buyer spot and the step between buyers, board = where boarding passengers walk.

_doc_booth: Ticket booth (CHECKLIST_EXPANSOES 2.1): buyers come as groups (adults, kids, a trait: hungry, first time) shown in a bubble. The player sells to the first group and picks which extras to offer: a wanted extra is bought (price per person or per group) and adds rating; an unwanted one is refused and costs pushy rating. A group that does not fit goes to the waiting list and comes first tomorrow. Rough sea: with tickets sold the player chooses refund (refund_rating) or reschedule to tomorrow (reschedule_rating, reschedule_keep of the groups stay); undecided by the end of the departure hour it is refunded. Group sizes: adults 1..max_adults, kids 0..max_kids (kid_chance).
_doc_boat: Playable boat tour (CHECKLIST_EXPANSOES 2.2, MareBoatTourWorld.cpp): the player pilots the tour boat (W/S throttle, A/D steer, gamepad left stick) from spawn through the route: buoys to pass (within buoy_radius) and three stops (stop: index into stops.barco) where the boat must slow under stop_speed inside stop_radius. Stop actions: vests (E on each passenger), dolphins (engine off and look at them; speeding toward them is the bad choice) and story (aim at look and press E). Leaving a stop unfinished gives the 'ok' or 'bad' choice. Dolphins come with dolphin_chance and add dolphin_bonus; full speed for seasick_seconds makes a passenger seasick (-seasick_rating, at most -1). Back at the dock (within dock_radius, slow) the tour is rated like a guided one. World cm; seats/helm in boat-local cm (bow -Y).

_doc_snorkel: Guided snorkel (CHECKLIST_EXPANSOES 2.3, MareSnorkelWorld.cpp): the tour boat anchors by the offshore reef (~9 m deep, MareReefWorld) (anchor x,y,heading; model origin at the transom, 'centre' cm ahead is the middle of the hull) and the group (one swimmer per ticket, at most 6) jumps in at the ladder and swims after the player (follow_speed, spacing). Species: aim at a fish school or coral kind within look_range and press E to present it (new species add species_bonus); touching coral (the hero within coral_margin of a coral's bounds) costs coral_penalty, at most once per coral_cooldown s. After lost_after species (or lost_seconds) one swimmer drifts lost_distance away and must be fetched (within fetch_radius). Back at the ladder (count_radius) the group is counted: everyone present ends the tour; a swimmer still lost after crew_fetch_seconds is fetched by the crew (worse choice). Choices per stop (stops.snorkel): 0 good, 1 ok, 2 bad - coral touches (0 / 1 / more), species presented (good_species / ok_species / fewer) and the count (all fetched / crew fetched). World cm.

_doc_trail: Lighthouse trail on foot (CHECKLIST_EXPANSOES 2.4, MareTrailWorld.cpp): the group (one walker per ticket, at most 5) gathers at start and walks after the player at 'speed' cm/s (the player walks 260, sprints 420), 'spacing' apart. At the start E on each walker hands water and sunscreen. A walker more than lag_distance behind complains (-complaint_rating, once per lag_cooldown s each). Mirantes (viewpoints, within 'radius'): P takes the group photo; E tells the lighthouse story while they rest (the clock jumps story_minutes, +story_bonus). At the lighthouse the group is gathered: inside the 'sunset' hours window they watch the sunset (+sunset_bonus, sunset_watch_minutes then the tour ends); early, they wait and grow impatient (a complaint every patience_minutes); late, it is missed. Choices per stop (stops.farol): water given (all / half / fewer), photos at the mirantes (all / some / none), sunset (seen / missed). Game clock: 1 minute per real second; sun at 0 deg at 18h. World cm.

_doc_results: Tour results (CHECKLIST_EXPANSOES 2.5, MareTours.cpp GuideTour/ToursHour): every tour that leaves (with the player or the guide) writes a result to the save ('tour_results', last 12): stars, tip, photos sold and up to three written reviews - one per stop, from reviews.<tour>[stop][choice] (0 good, 1 ok, 2 bad), signed by the groups that went - plus a highlight line when the playable trip's bonus was high or low (highlight.<tour>). The phone's Passeios app shows them. 'buzz': a rating of good or more brings extra people to the same tour tomorrow (bad fewer). The guide alone rates guide_rating (+ the extras' average) and earns no tip. Photographer: the Personalizar 'fotos' slot (tier 2+) sells photos after each tour, photo_price[tier-1] each, to photo_share of the passengers at a 5-star rating (fewer with a lower one). Upgrades in the playable tours: boat tier +boat_speed_per_tier speed and +seasick_seconds_per_tier; diving gear tier +look_range_per_tier and +species_bonus_per_tier.
